args.rationale:
The recommendation to purchase 800 units must be modified because ordering 800 units violates both node storage capacity (peak occupancy of 204.00 m³ exceeds the 200.00 m³ limit) and the max days of cover policy (closing inventory of 500 units represents 29.4 days of cover, exceeding the 12-day / 204-unit policy limit). 

Currently, NODE-BOG-F3 has 176 usable units on hand for SKU-1003 and constant daily forecast demand of 17 units/day with no open POs, leading to a projected stockout on 2026-09-27 and 300 units of total unmet demand over the 28-day horizon.

Ordering 500 units from SUP-A at $13.00/unit (total cost $6,500.00) with a 7-day lead time delivers stock on 2026-09-24—three days before the stockout. This order meets SUP-A's MOQ (250) and pack size (50), completely eliminates all 300 units of projected unmet demand, stays within physical storage capacity (peak occupancy of 198.00 m³), and complies with policy (closing inventory of 200 units / 11.8 days of cover).
